  the LifeHub brand. Vercel builds it from `client/` on every deploy (the
  root `package.json` "build" script, into `risers-journey/diagnostic/`,
  which is not committed): change the code in `client/`, push, and the
  live page updates. If that build fails, Vercel keeps the last working
  version of the whole site live. To build it locally: `npm run build` at
  the repo root.
